title: Worktree cargo build directories accumulate under .tmp until drive C: fills (0 bytes free on 2026-10-14 08:33Z), killing a full gate
outcome: Per-worktree cargo target directories under the repository's .tmp no longer grow without bound. A worktree whose item is landed, completed or released has its regenerable build directory removed by a defined owner and trigger (or builds share a bounded cache), and gates refuse to start, with a named message, when free disk space is below a safe threshold, instead of failing mid-compile with os error 112.
acceptance: Worktree cargo build directories accumulate under .tmp until drive C: fills (0 bytes free on 2026-10-14 08:33Z), killing a full gate is done
